name: Learning reader — book model, chapter format + reader surfaces (design)
objective: Design half of the learning-reader pair: research and settle the book/chapter model (codebase books from phases, subject books for general learning, versioned chapters, Korean/English variants), a native chapter format (refined diagrams, images, multi-column figures, quiz blocks) with a legacy path for existing HTML explainers, then design the reader-first surfaces - library, book page, reader, review - in Claude Design for phone, iPad and desktop, signed round by round.
